Agent-filed (open-brain session 2026-08-25, head Claude Fable 5).

## What happened

PR #763 (docs-only) run 32922625834, job `python-capture` on `open-brain-ct106`: `tests/test_capture_transcript.py::TestAgainstARealTranscript::test_operator_turns_are_found_and_tool_results_are_not` failed with `every user record was treated as an operator turn; tool results are leaking into the lane`. The push-event run of the same SHA passed.

## Why

`python/openbrain/tests/test_capture_transcript.py:690-730`: the test `rglob("*.jsonl")`s `LIVE_TRANSCRIPT_DIR` on the machine running the tests and takes the LARGEST transcript. On ct106 that file is a transcript whose every turn is `API Error: Unable to connect to API (ConnectionRefused)` (the log quotes it), so there are no tool results to distinguish and the `< user_records` assertion fails. The test's verdict depends on what happens to be on the runner's disk, not on the code under test.

## Ask

Pin the input: ship a fixture transcript (redacted) under `tests/fixtures/` and run the real-transcript variant only when an env var opts in (same pattern as the live canaries). Related flake family: #702.
